subject: REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4264/26 (171017 EUECYIYN NOV 2026).

A4279/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2611240700  C) 2611240900  E) REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A4264/26 (171017 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5214/26 (171303 EUECYIYN NOV 2026). 
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED: 
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM 
A5214/26 (171303 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS 
TO ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO 
PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS 
THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE 
AIS UNIT. 
FURTHERMORE, THE ALLEGATIONS CONTAINED IN REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM 
A5214/26 (171303 EUECYIYN NOV 2026) ARE ERRONEOUS, MISLEADING 
AND DEVOID OF ANY LEGAL BASIS. 
WITHIN THE FRAMEWORK OF ITS WELL KNOWN AND LONG STANDING POSITIONS, 
WHICH ARE IN FULL COMPLIANCE WITH INTERNATIONAL LAW, GREECE WILL 
CONTINUE TO PLAN AND CONDUCT MILITARY EXERCISES IN THESE AREAS, AS 
IT HAS REGULARLY BEEN DOING ALL ALONG. 
CONSEQUENTLY, THE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5214/26 (171303 EUECYIYN NOV 
2026) IS NULL AND VOID AND NOT APPLICABLE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS 
UIR. 
THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE NOTAM WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR IS 
THE ABOVE REF (A) A4264/26 ISSUED BY GREECE. 
FINALLY, THE HELLENIC END PART 1 OF 2
A4279/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/3705N02445E341 A) LGGG  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2611240700  C) 2611240900  E) AUTHORITIES CATEGORICALLY REJECT THE ATTEMPT 
BY TURKIYE TO INTRODUCE IN THE FLOW OF THE NOTAM ISSUING SYSTEM, 
POLITICALLY MOTIVATED STATEMENTS OF POSITIONS, WHICH, BESIDES BEING 
BASELESS, HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH THE FUNDAMENTAL PURPOSE OF THAT 
SYSTEM, NAMELY THE SAFETY OF AIR NAVIGATION. 
LIKEWISE, THE ABOVE REF (B) TURKISH NOTAM A5214/26 USES FALSE NAMES TO DESIGNATE THE SPECIFIC GREEK ISLANDS INSTEAD OF THEIR 
INTERNATIONALLY KNOWN NAMES. END PART 2 OF 2
